title: Evaluation of anti-quorum-sensing activity of pomegranate (Punica granatum L.) peel extract and punicalagin against Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1.
authors: Ibrahim, Bashar; Sahi̇n, Berfin; Duman, Humeyra; Erzurumlu, Yalcin; Kinayturk, Neslihan Kaya; Sahi̇n, Muge; Onem, Ebru
one_liner_zh: 该文评估石榴皮提取物及安石榴苷对铜绿假单胞菌群体感应系统的抑制作用，仅用分子对接模拟小分子与LasR受体结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL SIGNIFICANCE: Pomegranate (Punica granatum L.) peel, known for its antimicrobial properties, is an important plant in traditional medicine and offers a valuable resource for anti-virulence strategies amid increasing antibiotic resistance. AIM OF THE STUDY: To evaluate the anti-quorum-sensing (QS) activity of pomegranate peel extract and punicalagin, its primary compound, against Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1 and investigate the underlying mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The effects of sub-inhibitory doses of the extract and punicalagin on pyocyanin production, biofilm formation, and swarming motility were evaluated. Sub-inhibitory doses of the extract and punicalagin were evaluated for their effects on pyocyanin production, biofilm formation, and swarming motility. qRT-PCR was used to assess QS gene expression, and molecular docking modeled punicalagin-LasR receptor interaction. RESULTS: According to HPLC analysis, the predominant phenolics were protocatechuic acid and catechin. At subinhibitory concentrations (up to 76 %), punicalagin and the extract both markedly decreased swarming motility. The crude extract demonstrated superior anti-biofilm activity (66 % inhibition) in comparison to pure punicalagin. Furthermore, the extract significantly down-regulated all tested QS regulatory genes. Using molecular docking, it was found that the LasR receptor and punicalagin had a strong binding affinity (-7.5 kcal/mol). CONCLUSION: Pomegranate peel extract and punicalagin suppress P. aeruginosa's swarming and biofilm formation through anti-QS activity, establishing the peel as a promising anti-virulence candidate, likely due to synergistic effects.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学意义：石榴（Punica granatum L.）果皮以其抗菌特性著称，是传统医学中的重要植物，并在抗生素耐药性日益增加的背景下，为抗毒力策略提供了宝贵资源。研究目的：评估石榴皮提取物及其主要化合物安石榴苷（punicalagin）对铜绿假单胞菌PAO1的抗群体感应（anti-quorum-sensing, anti-QS）活性，并探讨其潜在机制。材料与方法：评估了亚抑制剂量提取物和安石榴苷对绿脓菌素产生、生物膜形成和群集运动的影响。亚抑制剂量提取物和安石榴苷对绿脓菌素产生、生物膜形成和群集运动的影响被评估。使用qRT-PCR评估QS基因表达，并通过分子对接模拟安石榴苷与LasR受体的相互作用。结果：根据HPLC分析，主要酚类物质为原儿茶酸和儿茶素。在亚抑制浓度（高达76%）下，安石榴苷和提取物均显著降低了群集运动。粗提取物在抗生物膜活性方面表现出优于纯安石榴苷的效果（抑制率为66%）。此外，提取物显著下调了所有测试的QS调控基因。通过分子对接发现，LasR受体与安石榴苷具有强结合亲和力（-7.5 kcal/mol）。结论：石榴皮提取物和安石榴苷通过抗QS活性抑制铜绿假单胞菌的群集运动和生物膜形成，确立了果皮作为有前景的抗毒力候选物，这可能是由于协同效应所致。
